title: usenet-ipfs-verify crate: skeleton, types, and SQLite store
description:
New MIT crate with the VerificationResult types and the store layer that reads/writes the two verification tables.

What: crates/verify/Cargo.toml + src/lib.rs + src/store.rs + src/types.rs

types.rs:
  pub enum CheckType { UsenetIpfsSig, Dkim }
  pub enum VerifyResult { Pass, Fail, NoKey, DnsError }
  pub struct VerificationRecord {
      pub check_type: CheckType,
      pub key_id: Option<String>,   -- sha256:<hex>
      pub result:   VerifyResult,
      pub detail:   Option<String>,
      pub verified_at: i64,
  }
  pub struct SeenKey {
      pub key_id:        String,
      pub key_type:      String,
      pub key_data:      Vec<u8>,
      pub cert_der:      Option<Vec<u8>>,   -- NULL in v1
      pub identity:      Option<String>,
      pub first_seen:    i64,
      pub last_seen:     i64,
      pub article_count: i64,
  }

store.rs (VerifyStore):
  pub struct VerifyStore { pool: Arc<SqlitePool> }
  pub async fn record_verification(&self, cid: &Cid, rec: &VerificationRecord)
    -- upserts seen_keys if key_id is Some (insert-or-ignore for new key; update last_seen+article_count if exists)
    -- inserts into article_verifications
  pub async fn get_verifications(&self, cid: &Cid) -> Vec<VerificationRecord>
  pub async fn get_key(&self, key_id: &str) -> Option<SeenKey>

lib.rs: re-exports types + store; declares pub mod verifiers (empty stubs for W1A/W1B to fill)

Cargo.toml: MIT license; deps: sqlx, cid, tracing, serde (for key_id helpers)

Defensive rules:
- key_id computation: sha256 of raw SubjectPublicKeyInfo bytes, hex-encoded, prefixed 'sha256:'.
- record_verification must not fail on duplicate article_cid+check_type (INSERT OR REPLACE).
